title: World bounds match the city (supersedes the size in REC-4)
intent: Let the player reach the whole 2880x1920 city

evidence.description: replaced the 2400x1600 arena with the 2880x1920 city
world and camera bounds 2880x1920; camera clamps at scroll 0,0 and 1600,1200

constraints.statement: Call physics.world.setBounds and camera.setBounds with WORLD_WIDTH x WORLD_HEIGHT from cityMap, because Arcade world bounds default to the 1280x720 canvas and would act as invisible walls

result.summary: REC-4 records the same constraint for the old 2400x1600 arena; the CLI has no way to mark it superseded
